what: TinyLlama WikiText-2 perplexity with the baseline recipe's arithmetic in every linear layer except the attention projections, next to the unpatched bf16 model. models/accuracy measures it; tests/selftest_accuracy.py [6] checks a cached measurement in the same environment against these numbers exactly.
note: The bf16 model's own loss depends on the torch / transformers versions (same 16 samples, same token counts, per-token loss differs by up to 1e-2 either way), so every number is tied to its environment. Under torch 2.9.1 / transformers 4.57.3 the chain recipe -> config/scheme -> models/accuracy reproduces mxq's recorded runs exactly: hw_fp8 (block.mxgemmini ties_away, 1e-38 floor, HW_FINAL ladder, matmul.compiled(MXGEMMINI)) = 7.343833269506588 and the bf16 model = 7.188464705866791, which are MXQuant's published bf16 measurement conditions. The standing regression number for the hardware's rounding (rne, 2^-23 floor) is the .venv one; it is expected to differ from the ties_away number because bf16 activations tie on about 1 in 16 elements when rounded to e4m3.
